q1_issues.issue: The proper name "House of Representatives" is fused with the lowercase modifier "state" into a class symbol and the referent is typed as a member of it, instead of the name being one opaque constant with an ordinary kind atom beside it.
Compound decomposition (a genus atom) is applied to a proper noun, which Compound concepts explicitly excludes.
No Name atom is emitted for the House of Representatives, although a Name fact is mandatory and not optional for an organization.

q2_gaps: a vote tally / score pair ("79-64") has no licensed encoding

a lowercase restrictive modifier distinguishing an institution from an identically named other ("the *state* House of Representatives") — the naming rule offers a sub-region witness (for a lowercase adjective before a place) or treating the adjacent lowercase noun as the entity's kind, and neither fits an institution-disambiguating modifier
notes: Everything outside the institution name follows the instruction set: the noun's infinitival complement as (To sk_move_1 sk_legalize_1) asserted tenselessly, the agentless passive, the bare deictic "yesterday", and Location on the event. (Inheritance medical_use medical) is a borderline modifier exposure — "medical" is an adjective but not one of the three exposed categories (gradable, positional/cardinal, material).
